message: Mike, can only speak for myself here.  I read because I'm interested in your basic premise.  But I cannot follow much of it because it's out of my area (like way out). Are people reading that share your same specific interests?  If not, perhaps it's difficult for others to follow as well.  Are you motivated to blog to work independently through your thoughts or to seek out peer interaction?  If it's the latter, perhaps a reconsideration but still, I'm not sure about shortening posts just to attract listeners in order to gain responses.  The people who really can appreciate what you are saying should be willing to sustain the entry, no?  Now that I consider it, I don't think you'd do that anyhow.
